Direct Poisson one-jump calculation gives a CDF reversal after a rigorous >=2-jump error bound. Standard-library checker verified numeric constants but does not replace all-parameter proof.

It substantially extends the source sufficient \(\alpha\le2\) region to a sharp 2.9065579 boundary, identifies a two-root failure geometry and supplies an explicit low-intensity risk-reversal witness.
